basis: Static review of all 15 lesson definitions, lab states, game markup, and validation handlers. Browser inspection of the file URL was blocked by browser policy; no prototype browser-play claim is made.
strong_features: Three concrete visual and textual subtype examples per unit
Concept-specific interaction metaphors: repaint, sound sorting, magnets, word surgery, shelf repair, bookending
Short explanations linking a manipulation to its effect
retain_from_current: Two distinct entry identities and the paper-craft writing workspace
Guide examples, source attribution, bottom coach, open navigation, saved progress, accessibility and offline runtime

review_findings.finding: The handler marks every single active pause as successful, irrespective of which sentence boundary is chosen.
review_findings.merge_action: Specify a pacing goal and assess its placement, or compare multiple supported choices.

review_findings.finding: The display begins at 9 words; the rendered sentence has 11. Subtracting the three removable phrases produces an incorrect live count, while final checking still accepts all three cuts.
review_findings.merge_action: Compute token counts from actual current text and test preserved meaning.

review_findings.finding: One fixed hidden meaning is marked correct without sufficiently constraining context.
review_findings.merge_action: Provide tone/action/context clues and retain multiple plausible readings where evidence is open.

review_findings.finding: The semicolon is treated as the single level solution and an em dash as grammatical but unsuccessful.
review_findings.merge_action: Assess a stated rhetorical purpose; retain the current colon/explanation example.

review_findings.finding: Some comparisons change content, structure, register, and mood simultaneously, making the cause of the effect difficult to isolate.
review_findings.merge_action: Hold the scenario and core information stable where appropriate and identify the changed variable.

recommended_core: User selected several short challenges in every unit. Plan three complementary challenges: notice, manipulate, transfer, with optional deeper examples.
delivery: 15 units × 3 short challenges; 45 subtype pairs and 45 named lab states; existing visual shell and semantic motion preserved
